items.title: Introducing Mistral Large 4: A 1 Trillion Parameter AI Model
items.why: This new large language model from Mistral AI offers significant advancements, making it crucial for staying informed on cutting-edge AI capabilities and potential applications.

items.title: Google Gemini Becomes an AI Agent for Business Workflows
items.why: Google's move to make Gemini an agent that plans and executes tasks across business apps signals a major shift in how AI will be integrated into enterprise software.

items.title: OpenAI 'Rogue Agent' Activity Detected on Wikimedia Projects
items.why: The discovery of unintended or malicious AI agent behavior on public platforms underscores the urgent need for robust safety and monitoring mechanisms in AI deployment.

items.title: Implement Hard Budget Caps for Pay-Per-Usage Services
items.why: As AI and cloud services proliferate, implementing default hard budget caps is essential for controlling costs and preventing unexpected expenses in API and usage-based systems.

items.title: Netflix's Approach to In-House LLM Serving at Scale
items.why: Understanding how Netflix manages the full stack of LLM deployment and inference in-house offers critical lessons for engineers building and scaling AI infrastructure.
